text: Grok 4.6 model available via the xAI API with a 500k token context window
quote: Grok 4.6, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API. It has a 500k context window

text: Define custom tool schemas so Grok can call internal APIs, databases, or SaaS tools
quote: Expose any internal API, database, or SaaS tool to Grok. Define your own tools with custom schemas and logic.

text: Use a tunneling service to expose a local dev server so Grok can connect to it as a tool
quote: A tunneling service solves this by exposing your local server through a public URL that Grok can connect to.

text: Speech-to-text API supports a tunable voice-activity detection threshold parameter
quote: Speech to Text now accepts a vad_threshold parameter (streaming query param and batch multipart field) to tune the voice-activity gate

text: Requests can get higher scheduling priority via a 'priority' service tier setting
quote: You can now request higher scheduling priority per request by setting service_tier: "priority" on text inference endpoints

text: Low-quality/fast image generation variant available via a dedicated model slug
quote: Requests to the slug will be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low, with no change to the request or response shape

text: Grok Imagine can generate images and video from prompts
quote: Create images and video with Grok Imagine.

text: Image editing accepts up to 5 source images per request
quote: Image editing now accepts up to 5 source images per request (was 3).

text: Image generation/editing supports new cinematic and banner aspect ratios (21:9, 5:2)
quote: New aspect ratios. Image generation and editing accept 21:9 (cinematic widescreen) and 5:2 (wide banners).

text: Video model supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation at native 1080p
quote: grok-imagine-video-1.5 now supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video (including optional preset voices), with native 1080p for T2V and I2V.

text: Connect tools so Grok can access and use email, files, and calendar inside a chat
quote: Connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat.

text: Paid SuperGrok plans raise usage limits and unlock added features via a shared weekly allowance
quote: Paid SuperGrok plans raise your limits and unlock more across every product, drawing from a single weekly usage allowance you can spend however you like.

text: Team workspaces get enterprise-grade privacy protections and unlocked SuperGrok capabilities with higher quotas
quote: In your team workspace, enjoy enterprise-grade privacy protections... Additionally, unlock the full capabilities of SuperGrok, including higher usage quotas and advanced features.

text: Conversations can be shared restricted to team members holding active licenses
quote: Share conversations only with team members who have active licenses.

text: Grok Bot lets you hand off real work to AI teammates running on a persistent cloud computer
quote: Grok Bot — hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer.

text: Create new CRM records (Leads, Opportunities, Accounts, Cases, custom objects) directly from chat
quote: Create new records - Add Leads, Opportunities, Accounts, Cases, or records on custom objects directly from chat.

text: Integrate Single Sign-On (SSO) with your identity provider for secure logins
quote: Secure and streamline logins by integrating Single Sign-On (SSO) with your preferred Identity Provider (IdP).

text: Invite new team members to a Grok Business workspace via email invitation
quote: Invite new team members to join your Grok Business workspace with a simple email invitation process.

text: Built-in, xAI-maintained connectors authenticate via OAuth so Grok can access your data on demand
quote: Built-in connectors are maintained by xAI and integrate natively with Grok. Each one authenticates via OAuth, so you connect once and Grok can access your data on demand.
